summary: Auth integration and finance regression retest completed: backend 8/8, demo login, Google redirect, callback failure handling, desktop logout, cookie/Bearer sessions, expiry handling, and mobile dashboard passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Hamburger button is visible but has no onClick behavior; mobile users cannot reveal the sidebar/logout action.

action_items: Implement the mobile menu toggle or provide a visible mobile logout control, then retest the mobile shell.
The pytest module requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be exported by the test runner; document or centralize test env loading to avoid collection failure when run without shell variables.
critical_code_review_comments: Shell renders a mobile-menu-button without state or handler, leaving an interactive control non-functional and hiding logout on mobile.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (auth, callback, dashboard, desktop logout passed; mobile menu failed)

seed_data_creation: Demo sessions and TEST_-prefixed controls/tags/transactions were created by regression tests; expiry test users/sessions were removed. No APIs were mocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google provider completion was not exercised because it requires provider access; dynamic OAuth redirect and invalid callback error state were verified. Mobile hamburger/logout remains to retest after implementation.
rca of the issue: Shell always renders aside logout, but responsive CSS hides the aside on mobile. The mobile-menu-button has no state, handler, or drawer implementation, so clicking it cannot expose the hidden navigation/logout controls.
